newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO UPS STAKE IN BUDI RAISIO TO 50 PCT.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO UPS STAKE IN BUDI RAISIO TO 50 PCT.

text.p: Finnish food, animal feeds and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy said in a statement on Friday it had raised its holding in Indonesian paper chemicals company PT Budi Raisio International to 50 percent from 18 percent.
"The shares were acquired from the Finnish Fund for Industrial Cooperation Ltd (Finnfund) and the private individuals Widarto and Santoso," Raisio said.
It did not give the price of the deal.
PT Budi Raisio International, which started operations in 1994, makes adhesives and binders for the paper industry out of tapioca starch.
The company's 1996 turnover will be about 22 million markka, and it has 40 employees, Raisio said.
The remaining 50 percent of PT Budi is owned by tapioca starch manufacturer ~PT Budi Acid Jaya~, it said.
